maria: Quick check-in on long-term platform roadmap item: routing guardrails + multi-region tenant resilience. Thinking PRD with a tiny policy DSL, clear launch gates, canary plan, and sales-facing expectations. reactions?

sunil: +1. Propose we codify precedence: tenant policy > region affinity > capacity fallback. Also define two modes: soft-quarantine (throttle + observability) and full-eviction (immediate reroute).

aj: Suggest prioritization metric: customer impact (40%), risk reduction (30%), engineering effort (30%). That will help gate scope for initial rollout.

taylor: Ops ask: need deterministic runbooks for surge and cross-region cutover. Telemetry triggers: 95p latency > X ms sustained, error rate > Y% over 5m, and cache miss spike. We'll define exact numbers in SLO doc.

olivia: Sales needs templated FAQ: expected cutover time, KV cache behavior, pricing for isolation lane. Also sample contract wording for residency guarantees.

maria: Draft launch gates I'm thinking: (a) DSL v1 implemented + unit tests, (b) Console exposes SLOs + rollout UI, (c) Canary with 2 tenants across different geos for 48h, (d) fallback to compatible model variant automated, (e) runbook validated with tabletop. Agree?
sunil: Also include compatibility matrix: what counts as a compatible fallback (model arch match, tokenizer alignment, quantization bounds). We'll include a small example DSL snippet in PRD.
taylor: Runbook skeleton: detect -> notify customer + ops -> shift to fallback lane -> preserve/flush cache per policy -> monitor 15m -> rollback if errors spike -> escalate. Console should surface one-click rollback + audit logs.
aj: I'll estimate effort for the top three epics tomorrow.
oloivia: Typo: Olivia. Also please add sales-facing SLA language about max failover time and whether data can leave jurisdiction during emergency.
sre-bot: Reminder: PRD draft target 2024-05-07 09:00 UTC.
maria: Perfect. I'll assemble PRD sections: overview, minimal DSL, compatibility rules, telemetry & SLOs, runbooks, canary plan, launch criteria, pricing appendix. Will ping for 48h review when ready.
